author: hattrill
body:
* **InterPro ID / label**
* Heme A synthase, type 1 (IPR023755)
* Heme A synthase, type 2 (IPR023754)
* COX15/CtaA family' (IPR003780)


* **Description of issue**

GO:0120547 'heme A synthase activity' should be used to replace 'oxidoreductase activity, acting on NAD(P)H, heme protein as acceptor' GO:0016653 for Heme A synthase, type 1 (IPR023755) & Heme A synthase, type 2 (IPR023754). 

Not sure about the parent 'COX15/CtaA family' (IPR003780) as it has two EC xrefs which map to 
EC 1.17.99.9 -> GO:0120547 heme A synthase activity
EC 2.5.1.141  -> GO:0008495 protoheme IX farnesyltransferase activity

the former is in the oxidoreductase branch and the latter is a transferase. But the current mapping to GO:0016653 is incorrect. I think that the EC 2.5.1.141 GO:0008495 mapping comes from this "In some cases, heme A synthase is found fused to protoheme IX farnesyltransferase, an enzyme that converts protoheme IX to heme O" but still the activity would not be a property of the heme A syn domain.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c271debb-f8bb-499e-b755-e9255ba1d1f5)

NTR: https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/29711
title: Mapping of Cox15/cta family to heme A synthase activity

author: blazaropinto
body:
Hi Helen,
Thank you for this. I removed [GO:0016653](http://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGo/GTerm?id=GO:0016653) from the three entries, but GO:0120547 is not available yet in our internal curation tool. I'll add it as soon as I can to both children entries. I agree the parent should be left without any of those GO terms in InterPro.
Best,
Beatriz

author: blazaropinto
body:
